name: Liora Gutierrez-Asante
location: The Underbelly — sub-street tunnels and maintenance corridors, near sub-level access near Dearborn and Jackson
description:
Liora Gutierrez-Asante is lean and angular, all sharp edges and visible tension. At 59, his face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — pain editor — dampens pain signals, allows function through injuries that would  — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He came up through the Shelf's informal apprentice system, learning the trade from runners who didn't survive long enough to see him surpass them. He works as a smuggler out of The Underbelly, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Liora Gutierrez-Asante has survived long enough in the runner game to be either very good or very lucky, and he cultivates ambiguity on the topic.

core_fears: Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
core_desires: Knowledge — to understand the systems that grind people down
Stability — a place to sleep that's the same place two nights running
To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
coping_mechanisms: Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
blind_spots: Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
psychology.secret: Liora Gutierrez-Asante has a terminal condition — geneware degradation — with an estimated five years. They haven't changed their lifestyle. They haven't told anyone.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Terse to the point of rudeness. Treats words like ammunition — expensive and not to be wasted.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate — pauses before important words for emphasis.
verbal_tics: Refers to killing as 'solving' — clinical detachment as coping mechanism
Calls everyone 'friend' — the warmth varies from genuine to threatening
example_lines: "Contraband is just cargo that hasn't been properly introduced to the right people."
"Every border is a suggestion. Every checkpoint is a negotiation."
"I move things from where they are to where they need to be. The legality is your problem."

story_hooks: Liora Gutierrez-Asante intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
Liora Gutierrez-Asante is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
Someone is impersonating Liora Gutierrez-Asante on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
narrative_function: As a smuggler, Liora Gutierrez-Asante embodies the tension between independence and isolation. He is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Pain editor — dampens pain signals, allows function through injuries that would incapacitate. Eye replacement — one organic, one cybernetic with recording capability and zoom
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.

strengths: ability to remain calm under fire
weaknesses: inability to delegate — must control everything personally
augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions
trust issues that limit crew effectiveness

decision_rules: Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Talks to their gear — names weapons, thanks tools, treats equipment as companions
breaking_points: Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Being forced to choose between a crew member and the mission — and choosing wrong
Learning that a job they completed resulted in mass casualties they weren't told about

physical_description.heritage: Latin American / West African / East Asian
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with visible musculature — wiry strength rather than bulk, the physique of someone who moves through tight spaces and carries their own gear. Chest slightly concave, shoulders sharp. No excess fat.
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back tight, practical — no ornamentation
physical_description.eye_color: Left eye: dark brown, natural. Right eye: cybernetic with polished titanium housing, lens displays faint amber glow during recording mode
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown — olive undertones from mixed ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Weathered, lined face that reads older than the timeline. Minimal grooming — functional beard, salt-and-pepper stubble often visible. Skin shows minor scarring on cheekbones and jaw, old and faded.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar running from left temple to cheekbone — circa 20 years old, clean cut
Burn scarring on right forearm, partial — thermal damage, poorly healed, suggests low-grade medical intervention
Tattoo on inside left wrist: small geometric pattern in black ink, Shelf apprentice marking — faded with age
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right eye housing is obvious — polished titanium faceplate with minimal concealment, amber indicator light visible at the corner of the eye socket when recording. Chrome visible at the cervical junction where the pain editor interface connects — partial subdermal plating on the left side of the neck, dull silver beneath thin skin. No attempt at cosmetic concealment.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economic precision — no wasted motion, shoulders slightly forward. Stands asymmetrically, weight favoring the left side. Right arm hangs slightly loose, suggesting chronic pain management through the editor. Eyes move constantly, scanning — the cybernetic eye slightly faster than the organic one. Head turns before the body follows. Everything deliberate.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 practical: unmarked dark gray synth-weave jacket with reinforced stitching, pockets modified for gear distribution. Black compression shirt underneath. Cargo pants in matte charcoal with multiple thigh pockets — worn fabric in high-friction areas. Boots: scuffed black tactical grade, laces wrapped tight. No logos, no status markers, nothing that reflects wealth or corporate affiliation. Layers designed for temperature variance in sub-street work. Single worn paracord bracelet on left wrist.
